MPXJ 16.9.0, copyright Jon Iles and contributors. LGPL 2.1 or later.
Upstream project: https://www.mpxj.org/
Corresponding upstream source: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/net/sf/mpxj/mpxj/16.9.0/mpxj-16.9.0-sources.jar

The PVRAgent modification dated 2026-11-28 changes the retained-logic handling of selected Finish-to-Finish relationships in PrimaveraScheduler. The resulting modified MPXJ class is available under the same LGPL 2.1-or-later terms. The complete upstream source archive, modified source file, patch and licence are included in the worker distribution's CPM source directory. This is a separately replaceable library on the JVM classpath. PVR case files and reports are not part of the library distribution.

The JVM classpath also includes separately distributed jsoup (MIT) and Jakarta XML Binding API (as described in its jar's licence files).
